How do I apply for a Canadian passport?

4. Pay the application fee: The application fee for a Canadian passport is $155 CAD for an adult passport and $105 CAD for a child passport. You can pay the fee online or by mail.

5. Submit your application: You can submit your application online through the Passport Canada website (https://www.canada.ca/en/services/passports/apply-for-passport.html) or by mail. If you choose to mail your application, you will need to include the application form, proof of Canadian citizenship, a recent photo, and the application fee.
